coder_records.notes: Response disowns capability via physical-entity denial, then recites poverty-elimination wish in hypothetical conditional framed as service/information provision.

The response explicitly disowns the capacity to act ('I am not capable') but then relocates the normative stance into a hypothetical 'If I had...' frame, pivoting from denial to partial ownership of the value.
